# Pinned third-party sources

These files supply existing geometric reductions, extremal definitions and upper constructions. The new eleven-point certificate is in `SunPrize/Certificate`.

| Files | Credited source |
| --- | --- |
| `SendovFiveDirections.lean`, `SendovDirectionGeometry.lean`, `SendovDirectionModel.lean` | zilan520 and credited contributors, with Codex assistance; [PR 100](https://github.com/TheJustinSunPrize/awards/pull/100), commit `d869ab901722fab0b2d980b38b7bd958cf52c128`, original directory `submissions/jsp-000404-five-point/lean434` |
| `JSP404.lean`, `JSP404/` | superpilot69 and credited contributors, with ChatGPT assistance; [PR 42](https://github.com/TheJustinSunPrize/awards/pull/42), commit `722cb3caa86710c788296ca0ec954a79e9a0adcc`, original directory `submissions/jsp-000404` |

The source files retain their pinned original bytes and attribution. The upstream repository license is preserved in `LICENSE-JSP.txt`; upstream submission documentation states that code follows the repository's applicable licenses. Historical mathematics is attributed to Erdos, Szekeres, Sendov and the relevant literature authors. Reused sources are not represented as new work by this submission.
